status: Frozen after physical-donor uniqueness remediation; no algorithm-superiority claim.

supersedes.reason: The prior control inventory could count multiple POCs from one physical donor site.

stable_synthetic_cases.split_assignment: Deterministic connected components of the complete target-plus-donor physical-site footprint; entire components are assigned to calibration or evaluation.

synthetic_perturbations.seed_derivation: 20260830 plus deterministic case, multiplier, and variant offsets

counterfactual.geographic_donor_rule: At most one POC per donor physical site, selected by pre-event correlation, distance, paired days, and POC tie-breaker.

threshold_selection: Optimize macro-F1 only on the 66 calibration cases; evaluate the unchanged threshold on 80 complete-input-disjoint cases.

selection_aware_bootstrap.scope: Re-selects and refits within a fixed observed geographic, method-stability, availability, and physical-site-unique candidate pool.

method_decision: See MODEL_DECISION.md; retained as a benchmark comparison, not a superiority claim.
